item.title: B.C. says AI and data centre projects must compete for power in new selection process
item.description: British Columbia’s government says it’s launching a competitive selection process for artificial intelligence and data centre projects that would see companies fight over a set amount of power. item.title: (UPDATE) Outage after vehicle goes into ditch and downs power line in Fort St. John
item.description: Thirteen residents in Fort St. John do not have power after a vehicle went into a ditch, hit a power pole and downed a line on 267 Road on January 30th.

item.title: Five new measles cases confirmed in northeast B.C.
item.description: Northern Health reported 338 confirmed measles cases on January 29th, with 318 of those cases being in northeast B.C. specifically.

item.title: Fort St. John non-profit seeks performers for 53rd annual talent show
item.description: The Fort St. John Child Development Centre is looking for performers for its 53rd annual talent show scheduled for March 6th.

item.title: Fort St. John RCMP officers promote Indigenous policing amid northern recruitment initiative
item.description: Fort St. John police officers - Constable Caitlyn Rissanen and Constable Chad Neustaeter - had the chance to promote the Indigenous Policing Service Program during Prince George Cougars' games between January 23rd to 25th as part of the RCMP's Northern Recruitment Initiative.

item.title: NEBC Trackers gets set to host championship for best U-18 teams in B.C.
item.description: The NEBC Trackers will host the eight-team BC Hockey Tier One Provincial Championship at the North Peace Arena and Pomeroy Sport Centre in March 2026.

item.title: (UPDATE) Pedestrian hit by vehicle in Fort St. John
item.description: A vehicle collided with a pedestrian on 100th Avenue on January 30th, 2026.

item.title: Fort St. John protest planned over status in Canada of man found guilty of killing girlfriend in Mexico
item.description: A protest is to be held in Fort St. John on February 8th at 12 p.m. to object to Ryan Friesen's 'freedom,' after he has newly been found guilty of killing his girlfriend Kiara Agnew in Mexico.

item.title: Fort St. John RCMP arrests three wanted people
item.description: In a series of press releases, the Fort St. John RCMP announced the arrests of wanted Charlynn Mae Woloschuk, Shayne Steve Karey and Chad Cameron Travis.

item.title: (UPDATE) Huskies’ final home game versus Vipers cancelled
item.description: The Fort St. John Huskies' last home game of the 2025-26 season against the Sexsmith Vipers was cancelled on January 30th due to freezing rain and travel conditions.
